# $f_4$ test of gene flow

```{r}
library(slendr)
init_env()

library(dplyr)   # manipulating tabular data
library(ggplot2) # data visualization
library(cowplot) # composing plots into panels
library(purrr)   # convenient looping functions
```

```{r}
ts_compute <- function(fun, replicates, model, sequence_length, recombination_rate, ...) {
  replicates <- seq_len(replicates)

  args <- list(...)

  df_list <- lapply(replicates, function(i) {
    ts <- msprime(model, sequence_length = sequence_length, recombination_rate = recombination_rate)
     <- ts_names(ts, split = "pop")
    args$ts <- ts
    browser()
    do.call(fun, args)
  })

  df <- do.call(rbind, f4_list)
  df$statistic <- as.character(substitute(ts_f4))
  df$rep <- replicates

  df
}
ts_compute(ts_f4, replicates = 20, model, W = "p4", X = "p3", Y = "p2", Z = "p1", sequence_length = 10e6, recombination_rate = 1e-8)
```

```{r}
p1 <- population("p1", time = 4000, N = 1000)
p2 <- population("p2", time = 3000, N = 1000, parent = p1)
p3 <- population("p3", time = 2000, N = 1000, parent = p2)
p4 <- population("p4", time = 1000, N = 1000, parent = p3)

model <- compile_model(list(p1, p2, p3, p4), generation_time = 1)
schedule <- schedule_sampling(model, times = 0, list(p1, 10), list(p2, 10), list(p3, 10), list(p4, 10))

plot_model(model, schedule = schedule)
```

```{r}
ts_replicate <- function(n, expr) {
  code <- substitute(expr)
  replicates <- seq_len(n)
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(replicates, function(i) eval(code)))
  df$rep <- replicates
  df
}

ts_replicate(
  n = 10,
  {
    ts <- msprime(model, sequence_length = 10e6, recombination_rate = 1e-8, schedule = schedule)
    samples <- ts_names(ts, split = "pop")
    ts_f4(ts, W = samples["p4"], X = samples["p3"], Y = samples["p2"], Z = samples["p1"], mode = "branch")
  }
)
```


```{r}
scenarios <- rbind(
  ts_compute(ts_f4, replicates = 20, model, W = "p4", X = "p3", Y = "p2", Z = "p1"),
  ts_compute(ts_f4, replicates = 20, model, W = "p4", X = "p1", Y = "p3", Z = "p2"),
  ts_compute(ts_f4, replicates = 20, model, W = "p4", X = "p2", Y = "p4", Z = "p1")
)
```


```{r}
plot_grid(

plot_model(model),

ggplot(scenarios, aes(statistic, f4)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red"),

nrow = 2

)
```
